basic_details.job_title: WBSETCL Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 202 Junior Engineer, Linesman and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Special Technical Assistant, Junior Engineer (Elect.) Gr.-II, Junior Surveyor and 2 more
basic_details.short_information: West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (WBSETCL), Kolkata, has invited applications for 202 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. REC/2026/04. The posts include Special Technical Assistant, Junior Engineer (Elect.) Gr.-II, Junior Surveyor, Office Executive and 1 more. The online application is open from 25 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: 3-year full-time Diploma in Electronics & Tele-Communication/Radio/Wireless, Electrical or Survey Engineering (technical posts); Graduation with 50% plus a computer course or BBA/BCA/B.Sc options (Office Executive); Madhyamik plus 2-year NCVT ITI in Wireman or Electrician (Linesman).

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Full time 3 years' Diploma in Electronics and Tele-Communication/Radio/Wireless Engineering from an Institute recognized by W.B. State Council of Tech. Education (renamed as West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development). Age limit: 18 to 37 years. Pay: LEVEL-6 Rs. 36800 – 106700. Qualification required: Passed full time 3 years' Diploma in Electrical Engineering from recognized Institute/College duly recognized by West Bengal State Council of Technical Education (renamed as West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development). Age limit: 18 to 37 years. Pay: LEVEL-6 Rs. 36800 – 106700. Qualification required: Full time 3 years' Diploma in Survey Engineering duly recognized by West Bengal Stat

salary_details.pay_scale: Level-6 Rs. 36800-106700 (Special Technical Assistant, Junior Engineer, Junior Surveyor); Level-4 Rs. 29000-84500 (Office Executive); Level-3 Rs. 23400-68900 (Linesman)

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking @ 0.33 Total 85 marks, 90 minutes; medium English except the Bengali/Nepali part Part-wise qualifying marks: Domain Knowledge 20, Bengali/Nepali 04, MS-Office 08 (Office Executive) Minimum aggregate: 40% UR/EWS groups, 35% OBC and SC groups, 30% ST and PwBD

how_to_apply: Click 'Click here to Apply online' under Employment Notification No. - REC/2026/04.
Keep a valid E-mail ID, active Mobile Number and certificate details ready.
No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application.
Details can be edited before submission; the form cannot be edited after submission.
important_instructions: Category once entered at online registration cannot be changed Mobile No. and E-mail ID once given cannot be changed Candidates may apply for more than one post at their own risk; CBT dates may overlap No travelling expenses for CBT/Personal Interview Scribe must be indicated in the online form; PwBD candidates with valid Annexure-I get 20 minutes per hour compensatory time In addition to Basic Pay, other allowances as admissible are payable as per Rules of the Company

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for WBSETCL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applicants must be Domicile of West Bengal; Domicile Certificate to be submitted at Personal Interview Ability to read, speak and write in Bengali / Nepali language Employees of Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must produce NOC at Personal Interview Final semester/year students may appear in CBT but must submit final result on the date of interview

Passed full time 3 years' Diploma in Electrical Engineering from recognized Institute/College duly recognized by West Bengal State Council of Technical Education (renamed as West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development)

Full time 3 years' Diploma in Survey Engineering duly recognized by West Bengal State Council of Tech. Education (renamed as West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development)

Graduation in any Discipline with 50% marks in aggregate or with minimum 50% marks in H.S. level, and a listed computer course; Or BBA/BCA with 50% in Graduation or HS; Or B.Sc with Honours in Statistics or Computer Science with 50% in Graduation or HS; Or Bachelor Degree with one full paper on Computer Science/Computer Application/IT with 50% in Graduation or HS; Or Bachelor Degree with MCA with 50% in Graduation or HS
Madhyamik or equivalent plus Trade Certificate under NCVT from any ITI under Director of Industrial Training, Govt. of West Bengal in the trade (2 years' duration): Wireman or Electrician

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation of one year in regular Pay Band, except Linesman Linesman: 3 months' on-job training, absorption after passing a written examination, then one year probation Posts 1 to 4: Bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- at joining and minimum 4 years' service including probation

content_sections.heading: How Will WBSETCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT) Personal Interview (15 marks) Pre-employment Medical Examination Police Verification and Caste/other certificate verification Shortlisting for Interview in 1:3 ratio in each category based on CBT performance Personal Interview carries 15 marks Final selection on combined CBT and Interview performance, medical fitness, vacancies and reservation rules CBT and Personal Interview to be held in Kolkata; CBT may be held in multiple cities of West Bengal

content_sections.text: Negative marking @ 0.33 Total 85 marks, 90 minutes; medium English except the Bengali/Nepali part Part-wise qualifying marks: Domain Knowledge 20, Bengali/Nepali 04, MS-Office 08 (Office Executive) Minimum aggregate: 40% UR/EWS groups, 35% OBC and SC groups, 30% ST and PwBD

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Age Proof Proof of Essential Educational Qualification Caste/EWS Certificate (if applicable) EC Card, Meritorious Sportsperson certificate, PwBD certificate (if applicable) NOC (if applicable) Domicile Certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WBSETCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online only from 25.11.2026 to 15.12.2026. Open the 'Career' link on www.wbsetcl.in. Click 'Click here to Apply online' under Employment Notification No. - REC/2026/04. Keep a valid E-mail ID, active Mobile Number and certificate details ready. No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application. Details can be edited before submission; the form cannot be edited after submission.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Category once entered at online registration cannot be changed Mobile No. and E-mail ID once given cannot be changed Candidates may apply for more than one post at their own risk; CBT dates may overlap No travelling expenses for CBT/Personal Interview Scribe must be indicated in the online form; PwBD candidates with valid Annexure-I get 20 minutes per hour compensatory time In addition to Basic Pay, other allowances as admissible are payable as per Rules of the Company

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WBSETCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in WBSETCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 202 vacancies: 40 Special Technical Assistant, 100 Junior Engineer (Elect.) Gr.-II, 2 Junior Surveyor, 20 Office Executive, 40 Linesman.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for WBSETCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All category of candidates: Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 37 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD Maximum age limit 45 years irrespective of category, Exempted Category (EC) Up to 45 years, Ex-Servicemen Service period (min. 6 months continuous) deducted from actual age; resultant age may exceed the maximum by up to 3 years, WBSETCL Employees Up to 45 years irrespective of caste category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: LEVEL-6 Rs. 36800 – 106700 for Special Technical Assistant, LEVEL-6 Rs. 36800 – 106700 for Junior Engineer (Elect.) Gr.-II, LEVEL-6 Rs. 36800 - 106700 for Junior Surveyor, LEVEL-4 Rs. 29000 – 84500 for Office Executive, LEVEL-3 Rs. 23400 – 68900 (during the training period, they will be paid the Basic & DA only) for Linesman.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 3-year full-time Diploma in Electronics & Tele-Communication/Radio/Wireless, Electrical or Survey Engineering (technical posts); Graduation with 50% plus a computer course or BBA/BCA/B.Sc options (Office Executive); Madhyamik plus 2-year NCVT ITI in Wireman or Electrician (Linesman). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be Domicile of West Bengal; Domicile Certificate to be submitted at Personal Interview. Ability to read, speak and write in Bengali / Nepali language. Employees of Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must produce NOC at Personal Interview. Final semester/year students may appear in CBT but must submit final result on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree from Open University / Distance Learning / Part time / Sandwich Course, except existing WBSETCL employees. SC/ST/OBC with caste certificates issued outside West Bengal are treated as General with no relaxation.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Computer Based Test (CBT). Personal Interview (15 marks). Pre-employment Medical Examination. Police Verification and Caste/other certificate verification.
